blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala’s bid for an Asian Games women’s singles gold medal ended with a 3-6, 6-3, 6-2 semifinal loss to China’s Wang Xiyu, but the Filipino tennis star had a simple answer when asked whether she regretted competing. “No.” “I feel like I have no regrets,” Eala added after settling for the bronze medal at Nagoya City Higashiyama Park Tennis Center in Japan. Eala had given herself an opportunity to reach the final after a strong opening set against Wang. Momentum shifted in the second.
